title: hamiltonians-kepler-orbits widget params
description: Bespoke widget for the §6 Kepler-orbits sweep on the hamiltonians-classical-mechanics topic. Two `<input type="range">` sliders ($E$, $L$) share a single .row above an SVG host showing the conic orbit (ellipse / parabola / hyperbola) parametrized by energy and angular momentum. The two-sliders-in-one-row layout matches `hamiltonians-kam-tori` (3 sliders) but is distinct from parametric-plot's per-row layout.

sliders.description: Sliders rendered side-by-side inside a single .row.
